Source: GBAWriter v1.2.0 by Halim Jarrar, commit
577ff2a88b80cd8673672fd16e8629649678fca5 (writer_core.cpp, writer_core.h).

writer_core.cpp is unchanged. writer_core.h: TEXT_CAPACITY lowered from
1024*1024 bytes to 63 for gbamp3's one-line fields (search, playlist names).
gbamp3 drives it through player/src/writer_glue.cpp.
